panels.title: Active FTL infrastructure
panels.description: Authoritative current active counts for ordinary FTL relays, Deep Space Relay Stations, and monitoring FTL beacons.

targets.query:
WITH latest_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(observed_at_ms) AS t
  FROM empire_device_snapshot
), latest AS (
  SELECT latest_time.t,
         MIN(snapshot.resolution_seconds) AS resolution_seconds
  FROM empire_device_snapshot AS snapshot, latest_time
  WHERE snapshot.observed_at_ms = latest_time.t
  GROUP BY latest_time.t
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN device_type = 'ftl_relay' AND status IN ('active','relaying')
    THEN device_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "FTL relays",
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE
    WHEN device_type = 'deep_space_relay_station' AND status IN ('active','relaying')

    WHEN device_type = 'ftl_beacon' AND status = 'monitoring'
    THEN device_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "FTL beacons"
FROM empire_device_snapshot AS snapshot, latest
WHERE snapshot.observed_at_ms = latest.t
  AND snapshot.resolution_seconds = latest.resolution_seconds

panels.title: Device population over time
panels.description: Reconstructed owned-device population, reverse-anchored from current managed state. Reconciliation deltas correct gaps as authoritative snapshots arrive.

targets.query:
WITH history AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM empire_meta WHERE key = 'history_start_ms'),
    $__from
  ) AS start_ms
), resolutions AS (
  SELECT observed_at_ms, MIN(resolution_seconds) AS resolution_seconds
  FROM empire_device_snapshot
  GROUP BY observed_at_ms
), authoritative AS (
  SELECT snapshot.observed_at_ms AS time_ms,
         snapshot.device_type AS series,
         SUM(snapshot.device_count) AS value
  FROM empire_device_snapshot AS snapshot
  JOIN resolutions USING(observed_at_ms, resolution_seconds)
  WHERE snapshot.device_type IN (${device_type:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY snapshot.observed_at_ms, snapshot.device_type
), anchor_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(time_ms) AS anchor_ms FROM authoritative
), series_values AS (
  SELECT series FROM authoritative, anchor_time WHERE time_ms = anchor_ms
  UNION
  SELECT delta.device_type AS series
  FROM empire_device_delta AS delta, anchor_time
  WHERE delta.device_type IN (${device_type:sqlstring})
    AND delta.occurred_at_ms < anchor_ms
), anchors AS (
  SELECT series_values.series,
         anchor_time.anchor_ms,
         MAX($__from, history.start_ms) AS start_ms,
         COALESCE((
           SELECT value FROM authoritative
           WHERE time_ms = anchor_time.anchor_ms AND series = series_values.series
         ), 0) AS anchor_value
  FROM series_values, anchor_time, history
  WHERE anchor_time.anchor_ms IS NOT NULL
), backfill_initial AS (
  SELECT anchors.series,
         anchors.start_ms AS time_ms,
         anchors.anchor_ms,
         anchors.anchor_value - COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(delta.delta)
           FROM empire_device_delta AS delta
           WHERE delta.device_type = anchors.series
             AND delta.occurred_at_ms >= anchors.start_ms
             AND delta.occurred_at_ms < anchors.anchor_ms
         ), 0) AS value
  FROM anchors
  WHERE anchors.start_ms < anchors.anchor_ms AND anchors.start_ms < $__to
), backfill_changes AS (
  SELECT delta.occurred_at_ms AS time_ms,
         delta.device_type AS series,
         SUM(delta.delta) AS delta
  FROM empire_device_delta AS delta
  JOIN anchors ON anchors.series = delta.device_type
  WHERE delta.occurred_at_ms >= anchors.start_ms
    AND delta.occurred_at_ms < anchors.anchor_ms
    AND delta.occurred_at_ms < $__to
  GROUP BY delta.occurred_at_ms, delta.device_type
), backfill_points AS (
  SELECT time_ms, series, value FROM backfill_initial
  UNION ALL
  SELECT changes.time_ms,
         changes.series,
         initial.value + SUM(changes.delta) OVER (
           PARTITION BY changes.series ORDER BY changes.time_ms ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
         ) AS value
  FROM backfill_changes AS changes
  JOIN backfill_initial AS initial USING(series)
), snapshot_points AS (
  SELECT authoritative.time_ms, authoritative.series, authoritative.value
  FROM authoritative, anchor_time
  WHERE authoritative.time_ms >= MAX($__from, anchor_time.anchor_ms)
    AND authoritative.time_ms < $__to
)
SELECT time_ms / 1000 AS time, value, series
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM backfill_points
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM snapshot_points
)
ORDER BY time_ms, series

panels.title: Active FTL infrastructure over time
panels.description: Active ordinary relays, Deep Space Relay Stations, and FTL beacons. Retained history is reverse-anchored to authoritative device snapshots; lifecycle events provide the pre-snapshot changes.

targets.query:
WITH history AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM empire_meta WHERE key = 'history_start_ms'),
    $__from
  ) AS start_ms
), kinds(kind, series, device_type) AS (
  VALUES
    ('active_ftl_relay', 'FTL relays', 'ftl_relay'),
    ('active_deep_space_relay_station', 'Deep Space Relay Stations', 'deep_space_relay_station'),
    ('active_ftl_beacon', 'FTL beacons', 'ftl_beacon')
), resolutions AS (
  SELECT observed_at_ms, MIN(resolution_seconds) AS resolution_seconds
  FROM empire_device_snapshot
  GROUP BY observed_at_ms
), authoritative AS (
  SELECT resolutions.observed_at_ms AS time_ms,
         kinds.kind,
         kinds.series,
         COALESCE(SUM(CASE
           WHEN snapshot.device_type = kinds.device_type
            AND (
              (kinds.kind IN ('active_ftl_relay','active_deep_space_relay_station')
               AND snapshot.status IN ('active','relaying'))
              OR
              (kinds.kind = 'active_ftl_beacon' AND snapshot.status = 'monitoring')
            )
           THEN snapshot.device_count ELSE 0 END), 0) AS value
  FROM resolutions
  CROSS JOIN kinds
  LEFT JOIN empire_device_snapshot AS snapshot
    ON snapshot.observed_at_ms = resolutions.observed_at_ms
   AND snapshot.resolution_seconds = resolutions.resolution_seconds
   AND snapshot.device_type = kinds.device_type
  GROUP BY resolutions.observed_at_ms, kinds.kind, kinds.series
), anchor_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(time_ms) AS anchor_ms FROM authoritative
), anchors AS (
  SELECT authoritative.kind,
         authoritative.series,
         authoritative.time_ms AS anchor_ms,
         authoritative.value AS anchor_value,
         MAX($__from, history.start_ms) AS start_ms
  FROM authoritative, history, anchor_time
  WHERE authoritative.time_ms = anchor_time.anchor_ms
), backfill_initial AS (
  SELECT anchors.start_ms AS time_ms,
         anchors.kind,
         anchors.series,
         anchors.anchor_ms,
         anchors.anchor_value - COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(delta.delta)
           FROM empire_infrastructure_delta AS delta
           WHERE delta.kind = anchors.kind
             AND delta.occurred_at_ms >= anchors.start_ms
             AND delta.occurred_at_ms < anchors.anchor_ms
         ), 0) AS value
  FROM anchors
  WHERE anchors.start_ms < anchors.anchor_ms
    AND anchors.start_ms < $__to
), backfill_changes AS (
  SELECT delta.occurred_at_ms AS time_ms,
         delta.kind,
         anchors.series,
         SUM(delta.delta) AS delta
  FROM empire_infrastructure_delta AS delta
  JOIN anchors ON anchors.kind = delta.kind
  WHERE delta.occurred_at_ms >= anchors.start_ms
    AND delta.occurred_at_ms < anchors.anchor_ms
    AND delta.occurred_at_ms < $__to
  GROUP BY delta.occurred_at_ms, delta.kind, anchors.series
), backfill_points AS (
  SELECT time_ms, kind, series, value
  FROM backfill_initial
  UNION ALL
  SELECT changes.time_ms,
         changes.kind,
         changes.series,
         initial.value + SUM(changes.delta) OVER (
           PARTITION BY changes.kind
           ORDER BY changes.time_ms ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
         ) AS value
  FROM backfill_changes AS changes
  JOIN backfill_initial AS initial USING(kind, series)
), snapshot_points AS (
  SELECT authoritative.time_ms,
         authoritative.kind,
         authoritative.series,
         authoritative.value
  FROM authoritative
  JOIN anchors USING(kind, series)
  WHERE authoritative.time_ms >= MAX($__from, anchors.anchor_ms)
    AND authoritative.time_ms < $__to
)
SELECT time_ms / 1000 AS time,
       series,
       value
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM backfill_points
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM snapshot_points
)
ORDER BY time_ms, series
